aggravating_circumstances: Use of weapons, Common intention, Assault on multiple victims
mitigating_circumstances: Injuries sustained by accused were minor, Attempt to save victim
trial_court_outcome: Convicted 6 out of 11 accused under Section 302 read with Section 149 of IPC and sentenced to life imprisonment
high_court_outcome: Confirmed conviction of A-1, A-2, and A-7 under Section 302 read with Section 34 of IPC and acquitted A-3, A-4, and A-10
offence_finally_established: Murder under Section 302 read with Section 34 of IPC
neutral_facts: The accused assaulted the victim with weapons such as sticks, stones, and an axe, causing grievous injuries. The victim was taken to the hospital by the accused and others, where he later died. The prosecution witnesses, who were injured during the incident, provided detailed accounts of the assault and the weapons used. The victim was unconscious throughout the incident, and the delay in lodging the FIR was explained by the efforts to save his life. Medical evidence linked the injuries to the accused, establishing the cause of death as head injury with multiple injuries.
